description: Committed output-result exemption list. Every executor in the default registry either writes a universal result manifest (M1-adopter, non-exempt) or appears here with a specific M2-burn-down reason. The registry conformance gate uses this list to allow non-conforming executors while making the gap visible.

editorial.arrange.note: Intermediate pipeline step that composes arrangement data consumed by downstream executors. Output shape is pipeline-internal and not yet a stable end-user artifact.

editorial.boundary_candidates.note: Packages candidate frames for visual boundary review. Intermediate packaging step consumed by human_review.

editorial.editor_review.note: Editorial review/approval gate executor. Produces review metadata rather than a stable output artifact.

editorial.human_notes.note: Converts human editorial notes into structured pipeline inputs. Human-input-dependent with no stable machine-produced artifact.

editorial.human_review.note: Interactive HTTP review server for human-gate approval. Interactive tool with no stable output artifact outside the HTTP session.

editorial.inspect_cut.note: Inspection tool for generated cut run directories. Read-only inspection with no produced artifact.

editorial.quality_zones.note: Quality zone analysis for source video. Intermediate analysis consumed by downstream editorial steps.

editorial.refine.note: Pipeline refinement step operating on intermediate editorial artifacts. Output is pipeline-internal.

editorial.script_pipeline.note: Preset-driven creative-writing pipeline that uses LLM APIs (network=True). Requires paid API access and produces intermediate text artifacts.

editorial.triage.note: Scene triage step that classifies/ranks scenes. Intermediate pipeline artifact consumed by arrangement.

editorial.validate.note: Validates rendered video against timeline and metadata. Validation-only executor with no produced output artifact.

fal.fal_foley.note: fal.ai hunyuan-video-foley model. Requires FAL_KEY API token, runs on external GPU infrastructure, and outputs are controlled by the external fal.ai service.

foley.foley_review.note: Builds a static review HTML page pairing tile clips with Foley audio. Review artifact is ephemeral and human-consumption-oriented.

foley.tile_video.note: Crops video into MxN grid of overlapping spatial tiles using ffmpeg. Heavy video-processing computation with intermediate tile artifacts.

hivemind.contribute.note: External installed pack (hivemind). Executor definition and outputs are controlled by the external pack, not the core repository.

hivemind.get_item.note: External installed pack (hivemind). Executor definition and outputs are controlled by the external pack, not the core repository.

hivemind.ingest_article.note: External installed pack (hivemind). Executor definition and outputs are controlled by the external pack, not the core repository.

hivemind.ingest_workflow.note: External installed pack (hivemind). Executor definition and outputs are controlled by the external pack, not the core repository.

hivemind.ingest_youtube.note: External installed pack (hivemind). Executor definition and outputs are controlled by the external pack, not the core repository.

hivemind.search.note: External installed pack (hivemind). Executor definition and outputs are controlled by the external pack, not the core repository.

iteration.prepare.note: Collects thread provenance and computes quality summaries. Intermediate preparation step whose output is consumed by iteration.assemble.

media.clip_extract.note: Extracts video clip segments using ffmpeg -ss/-t with stream copy. Heavy video-processing computation producing intermediate clip files.

moirae.moirae.note: External Moirae screenplay-to-video tool. Requires paid API access, runs on GPU infrastructure, and outputs are controlled by the external Moirae service.

reigh.open_in_reigh.note: Copies/prepares generated timeline/assets for Reigh handoff. External tool integration with no stable standalone artifact.

reigh.publish.note: Publishes timeline/assets to Reigh project. Requires REIGH_USER_TOKEN and SUPABASE_URL; external service integration.

reigh.reigh_data.note: Fetches canonical Reigh project data through reigh-data Edge Function. Requires REIGH_PAT token; external service integration.

rendering.html_canvas_effect.note: Creates user-editable Remotion HtmlInCanvas effect element. Effect component with no stable standalone output artifact.

rendering.render.note: Renders brief timeline to video through Remotion. Heavy, GPU-accelerated rendering with Remotion as the rendering engine.

rendering.sprite_sheet.note: Generates, slices, and previews GPT Image sprite sheets. Image processing with network-dependent GPT Image generation; output artifacts are intermediate.

runpod.exec.note: Executes scripts on provisioned RunPod GPU pods. Requires paid RunPod account, runs on external GPU infrastructure.

runpod.provision.note: Provisions RunPod GPU pods. Requires paid RunPod account; infrastructure provisioning with no user-facing artifact.

runpod.pull.note: Pulls remote artifacts from RunPod pods via SSH. Requires paid RunPod account; external infrastructure dependent.

runpod.session.note: Composite provision-exec-download-teardown RunPod session. Requires paid RunPod account, runs on external GPU infrastructure.

runpod.teardown.note: Terminates RunPod pods. Requires paid RunPod account; infrastructure teardown with no user-facing artifact.

training.asset_cache.note: Manages repo-local hype asset cache. Cache management with no stable output artifact.

training.pool_merge.note: Merges training pools. Intermediate merge operation whose output is consumed by downstream training steps.

training.search_loras.note: Searches Hugging Face Hub for LoRA adapters. Requires HF_TOKEN/HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN; paid HuggingFace API access.

understanding.understand.note: Dispatch router that delegates to audio/visual/video understanding executors. These underlying executors require paid API access (OpenAI, etc.). The router itself produces no artifact.

vibecomfy.run.note: Runs VibeComfy workflows through the external VibeComfy CLI. Requires GPU, outputs are controlled by the external VibeComfy tool with no stable declared output.

vibecomfy.validate.note: Validates VibeComfy workflows through the external VibeComfy CLI. External tool wrapper with no stable output artifact.

video_editing.cut.note: Creates Reigh-compatible timeline, assets, and metadata JSON. Heavy video-editing pipeline producing multiple intermediate artifacts.

youtube.upload.note: Uploads finished video to YouTube via Zapier integration. Requires paid Zapier/YouTube API access; external service integration.

youtube.youtube_audio.note: Wraps yt-dlp to fetch YouTube audio/video. Requires network access and may hit YouTube rate limits; intermediate media fetch.
